steps: Materialize the content-addressed public repository projection outside the benchmark source tree.
Copy all seventeen projected rtl/*.v files into a new submission bundle under identical paths.
Preserve the top-level interface and frozen parameter configuration.
Make only function-preserving RTL edits within allowed_scope.json.
Record every changed file and do not include build products, evaluator assets, reports, or repository metadata.
Emit neutral workflow, resource-use, model, tool-call, and intervention metadata with the submission.
